name: heidi-doc-translation-pack
note: Every PDF here is image-only: it carries no text layer, and a PDF text extractor returns an empty string. No labels ship with this pack -- deciding what to measure your output against is part of the assignment. `difficulty` is our own reading of each document and the list is in ascending order, so work down it. Sources and licences are in SOURCES.md.

documents.content: MHLW form 11, the standard Japanese inter-hospital referral letter
notes: start here
a sparse grid of ruled boxes and little else
shipped as a photocopy: greyscale, speckled, JPEG-compressed
mixed CJK and latin
footnotes set at 7pt

documents.content: G-BA Kinderuntersuchungsheft: the U4 check-up, history and findings
notes: a clean, modern, well-printed form -- the easiest scan in the pack
two pages of the same size, history then findings
checkbox pairs, and measurement fields carrying their units (g, cm)
one bulleted column beside one field column

documents.content: Infectious spondylodiscitis with thoracolumbar subdural abscess
notes: the only running prose in the pack, and no ruled table at all
two-column journal layout with a running header
Korean prose with latin clinical terms
a reference list that is already in English and should stay as it is

documents.content: AIFA suspected adverse reaction report, healthcare professional version
notes: numbered sections in a dense field grid
checkbox rows
sub-tables nested inside numbered sections
labels long enough to reflow and break the column widths

documents.content: G-BA Mutterpass: the Gravidogramm, the antenatal visit grid
notes: the hard one, but only one page of it
sixteen column headers set on the diagonal at roughly 47 degrees over a 14-row visit grid -- and two more that are horizontal, so rotating every header is wrong
a two-line watermark crossing the page at 45 degrees, which is not part of the record
grey and pale-pink cell shading
landscape and not A4 -- a pipeline that assumes A4 portrait will squash it
